failure_summary.description: Chose a salient related answer instead of the answer type or referent specified by the clue, despite existing whole-clue and answer-slot checks.
Used a modern company name where the clue referred to the organization under its historical name at the time of the event.

patch.reasoning: Most failures are already covered by the skill's answer-slot and complete-clue rules, so repeating them would not address the gap. Add a focused rule for historically situated organization names.

edits.content: - For historically situated events, use the organization or brand name that applied at the time. Do not substitute a later rebrand, merged successor, or modern umbrella name unless the clue or context calls for it.
